title: Hi-Fidelity Brewing
venue_description:
Hi-Fidelity Brewing

Hi-Fidelity is a Portland craft brewery producing small batch beers that range from bold and hoppy IPAs to rich and velvety stouts. The taproom serves onsite food including burgers and tacos and leans into a creative music-and-community identity.

Atmosphere and Setting

The brewery describes its taproom as a creative space full of creative people. Cribbage games and trivia sit alongside live music and open mic nights which gives the room a relaxed neighborhood feel rather than a formal concert atmosphere.

Original Music Open Mic

Every Monday night from 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM Hi-Fidelity hosts an open mic focused on original music by local songwriters. The sign-up list goes up at the brewery at 6:30 PM. Sets run about 10 minutes with 5 minutes for setup and teardown so most performers should plan on two songs and possibly more if the night is running on time. The sound is live mixed and the brewery says the night is open to all types of performers though it prioritizes original compositions over covers.

Other Programming

Beyond the Monday open mic the brewery also hosts comedy nights and jam sessions plus live music performances and trivia throughout the week.

For Performers

Bring original material and arrive by 6:30 PM to get on the list. If you mainly play covers this is probably not the right night.

Good to Know

Hi-Fidelity is located at 200 Anderson St Bay 6 Portland ME 04101. Questions about the open mic can go to dante@hifidelitybeer.com. Check the brewery's event calendar for the current schedule before heading over.

title: Blue Portland Maine (BPM)
venue_description:
Blue Portland Maine (BPM)

BPM is a nonprofit arts organization and music venue on Congress Street in downtown Portland that hosts roughly 300 performances every year. Its programming features local and touring musicians playing jazz and Celtic and Middle Eastern music plus blues and bluegrass and folk.

Atmosphere and Setting

Blue is an intimate room that also serves fine wines and Maine craft brews along with spirits and a small menu. As a nonprofit its proceeds go back into community events which gives the space a supportive artist-first feel.

Tuesday Open Mic

Every Tuesday BPM runs an open mic from 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM with doors at 6:00 PM. Music performances begin at 7:00 PM and comedy follows at 9:30 PM. Sign-up is handled through online forms that open at noon on the day of the show and close at 6:00 PM or when the slots fill. In-person sign-up is available if online slots run out and a finalized lineup is posted before each event. Admission is pay what you can with cash at the door or prepaid online and all money collected supports BPM's community events.

Other Programming

BPM also hosts a weekly Portland Drawing Group on Mondays and a Wednesday evening wine gig series along with a steady calendar of jazz and folk and world music shows.

For Performers

Sign up online early in the day on Tuesday since slots can fill. Music goes first so plan to be ready by 7:00 PM.

Good to Know

BPM is located at 650A Congress St Portland ME 04101. The venue is 18+ and guests under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. Submit the music sign-up form rather than the comedy form if you want a music slot.

title: Rising Tide Brewing
venue_description:
Rising Tide Brewing

Rising Tide is an independent family-owned craft brewery anchoring Portland's East Bayside neighborhood. The tasting room lets visitors enjoy cold beers and hot food from partner restaurant Ugly Duckling.

Atmosphere and Setting

The tasting room is a casual brewery setting where music is part of the weekly rhythm. It is open seven days a week with Sunday hours ending earlier at 6:00 PM.

Tuesday Bluegrass Night

Every Tuesday from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM the East Bayside Bluegrass Collective takes over the tasting room. The night is hosted by Joe K. Walsh and Steve Roy and features rotating musicians. The event is free with no cover charge and the Bluegrass Music Association of Maine lists it as welcoming all skill levels. Music starts at 7:00 PM and guests are encouraged to arrive early.

Other Programming

Rising Tide also runs regular brewery events beyond the bluegrass night so check the events page for the current lineup.

For Performers

Pickers who want to join in should introduce themselves to the hosts early since the night centers on the collective's rotating lineup.

Good to Know

Rising Tide is located at 103 Fox St Portland ME 04101. The tasting room opens at noon and closes at 9:00 PM Monday through Saturday and at 6:00 PM on Sundays.

title: Root Wild
venue_description:
Root Wild

Root Wild is a Portland maker of kombucha and artisanal fermented beverages with a taproom on Washington Avenue.

Atmosphere and Setting

It is a beverage-focused space that opens its room to community acoustic music which makes it a friendly early evening stop for players who want to pick and head home at a reasonable hour.

Wednesday Bluegrass Jam

Every Wednesday from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM Root Wild hosts a bluegrass jam led by Colin McKenna and listed by the Bluegrass Music Association of Maine. The early evening timeslot suits players who want to pick before dinner or head home at a reasonable hour.

Other Programming

Check Root Wild's website and social media for other events and taproom hours.

For Performers

Bring an acoustic instrument and be ready to trade tunes. The listing does not specify a skill level so ask the host when you arrive.

Good to Know

Root Wild is located at 135 Washington Ave Portland ME 04101. Confirm the jam is running on the week you plan to visit since community jams can shift.

title: One Longfellow Square
venue_description:
One Longfellow Square

One Longfellow Square calls itself Portland's Listening Room and Portland's most intimate music venue. It sits in the city's West End at the entrance to the Arts District and offers a warm and intimate atmosphere for live music and performing arts and community events.

Atmosphere and Setting

As a listening room the focus is on the performer and the audience paying attention which makes it a memorable place for a first stage experience in front of a friendly crowd.

Monthly Open Mic Night

One Longfellow Square hosts an open mic on the first Wednesday of the month from 7:00 PM to 9:30 PM. Each month features a different host and often a featured artist. Recent listings include hosts Sigrid Sibley and Melvin Gradiz and Thomas Clukey with Curl Tapes as a featured act in October. Details and sign-up information are available through the event page for each month.

Other Programming

The venue offers live streaming for select shows and free outdoor concerts in Congress Square Park as part of its access initiatives.

For Performers

Because the open mic is monthly and hosted by a rotating artist check the specific event page for that month's sign-up instructions.

Good to Know

One Longfellow Square is located at 181 State St Suite 201 Portland ME 04101. The box office is open Fridays from noon to 3:00 PM.

title: Lenny's Pub
venue_description:
Lenny's Pub

Lenny's Pub is a live music venue on Route 302 in Westbrook next to the big old HAWKES sign at Al Hawkes Plaza. The space once housed Event Records an independent bluegrass and country label founded by Al Hawkes in 1956.

Atmosphere and Setting

New owners Adam Steinman and Susan Erickson and Jill Murphy took over in March 2026 and describe their philosophy as treating patrons like family. Chef and co-owner Susan Erickson runs the kitchen with home-cooked food at fair prices and dedicated gluten-free options.

Bluegrass Jam

On the first Sunday of each month from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM Lenny's hosts an intermediate to advanced bluegrass jam listed on Melissa Bragdon Caron's calendar. The venue's history with bluegrass and country records makes it a fitting home for the session.

Other Programming

Lenny's books live bands and regular performers such as Travis James Humphries and Rose Alley plus vinyl music nights. Cover charges apply on Friday and Saturday and for larger acts.

For Performers

The jam is pitched at intermediate and advanced players so brush up on standard bluegrass repertoire and bring an acoustic instrument.

Good to Know

Lenny's is located at 1274 Bridgton Rd Westbrook ME 04092. Hours are Tuesday through Saturday from 4:00 PM to 10:00 PM and Sunday from noon to 6:00 PM. Since ownership recently changed confirm the jam schedule with the pub before visiting.

title: Westbrook On Tap
venue_description:
Westbrook On Tap

Westbrook On Tap is a craft beer taproom in downtown Westbrook with rotating local and regional brews and pub-style food. The venue offers spacious seating and an outdoor patio.

Atmosphere and Setting

The room emphasizes a community atmosphere and an intimate setting that works well for an open mic where friends and neighbors come out to support each other.

Friday Open Mic

The Friday open mic starts at 6:00 PM and is hosted by Paul Conner. A full PA is provided. The night welcomes music and comedy and poetry.

Other Programming

Check the taproom's Facebook and Instagram pages for special events and live entertainment.

For Performers

A full PA is provided so you only need your instrument.

Good to Know

Westbrook On Tap is located at 1 Westbrook Common Suite 4 Westbrook ME 04092. Hours are Tuesday through Thursday from 4:00 PM to 9:00 PM and Friday from 4:00 PM to 10:00 PM and weekends from 3:00 PM to 9:00 PM. The taproom is closed Mondays. The open mic listing on OpenMikes.org was last confirmed in early 2026 so call ahead.
